channel.title: Commute Oncology
channel.description: A personal revision podcast on the lines of treatment for prostate, kidney and bladder cancer in England. Scripts are drafted by AI from NICE, NHS England, ESMO and RCR sources and voiced by synthetic speech. Not clinical advice: check current guidance and local protocols.
channel.itunes:author: Commute Oncology

item.title: Ep 7 · Platinum then avelumab maintenance, and PSA relapse after prostatectomy
item.description:
Bladder: gemcitabine with cisplatin or carboplatin, then avelumab maintenance if the end-of-chemotherapy scan shows no progression, with Javelin Bladder 100, the avelumab form and where Europe differs. Prostate: a rising PSA after prostatectomy, NICE's offer of prostate bed radiotherapy, Europe's timing, risk groups and hormones, and Embark's enzalutamide as European guideline only.

item.title: Ep 6 · Non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and the bladder return visit
item.description:
Apalutamide or darolutamide when PSA is rising on hormones with clean conventional scans: forms APA1 and DARO1, Spartan, Aramis and Prosper, enzalutamide as European guideline only, and the open question of PSMA PET. Then a return visit to first-line metastatic bladder cancer: EV-302 survival in each arm, what the enfortumab form asks, and where Europe and England differ. Corrections to Eps 1, 2 and 3.

item.title: Ep 5 · High-risk non-metastatic prostate cancer and adjuvant immunotherapy after nephrectomy
item.description:
Two years of abiraterone with radiotherapy and hormones in high-risk non-metastatic prostate cancer: form ABI5's two doors, Stampede, and how Europe differs on relapse. Then adjuvant pembrolizumab after nephrectomy: the form's stage boxes, Keynote five six four, and where the form goes beyond the trial.

item.title: Ep 4 · Chemotherapy before cystectomy, and BRCA and PARP inhibitors
item.description:
Neoadjuvant cisplatin in muscle-invasive bladder cancer, and the change in March 2026: England now funds durvalumab with it, on form DUR8. Then PARP inhibitors in prostate cancer: olaparib alone after a newer hormone drug needs BRCA, while the combination forms ask for no mutation. Where Europe and England differ on both.

item.title: Ep 3 · Triplet therapy and docetaxel alone, and second-line kidney cancer
item.description:
Triplet therapy and docetaxel alone in hormone-sensitive metastatic prostate cancer, including NHS England's darolutamide triplet form and where the European guideline parts from NICE. Then second-line treatment in kidney cancer, where the first-line form decides the list. A "You asked" chapter on when abiraterone is chosen.

item.title: Ep 2 · After a newer hormone drug in prostate cancer, and first-line metastatic bladder cancer
item.description:

item.title: Corrected in Ep 2 · Ep 1 · Metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer and first-line kidney cancer (Gemini voices)
item.description:
